goal: Internationalisation review: text in code, plural rules, dates, numbers and right-to-left layout.
use: Internationalisation review: text in code, plural rules, dates, numbers and right-to-left layout. Use when a product is translated or entered in a new locale.

steps.note: List the strings. Find text written directly in code.
Check plurals. Flag sentences built by joining words.
Check dates and numbers. Flag formats that are hard-coded.
Check layout. Flag fixed widths that break in longer languages or right-to-left.
Report. Each string or format with its location and the fix.
